name: ihp_lna_2p45g
description: 2.45 GHz ISM-band CMOS LNA, cascode CS core (MMn2 input, MMn1 cascode) with inductive source degeneration (LLs1), gate-inductor input match (LLi), inductive drain/tank load (LLl), diode-connected NMOS bias generator (MM3) with a shunt-feedback-style bias resistor network (RRrf/RR_pol), 5 VDD-VSS decoupling caps, and one apparently-dummy all-grounded transistor (MMn3, kept as found -- see notes). Harvested from IHP's open-source SG13G2 tapeout program.

source.project: IHP-GmbH open-source SG13G2 tapeout, May 2025 campaign
source.license: Apache-2.0 (same repo family as ihp-gps-lna-nmos/npn; verified at TO_Apr2025 root and assumed consistent across IHP-GmbH TO_* campaigns -- not re-verified per-repo this time)
source.format_as_retrieved: xschem schematic capture file (graphical/coordinate-based, NOT a flat netlist) -- this is the first circuit converted via the new geometry-based flattener (lna/data/external/_tools/xschem_flatten.py) built this session, rather than from an already-flattened SPICE export.

conversion.route: raw .sch -> lna/data/external/_tools/xschem_flatten.py (parses sg13g2_pr/generic-xschem .sym pin geometry, applies the verified rotation/mirror transform, reconstructs nets via coordinate union-find, drops pads/ESD/sources by symbol K{type=} classification) -> flat SPICE text -> spice2genie.convert() -> upstream graph/augmentation (execed read-only) -> token sequence -> lna/topology.py screen -> lna/to_spice.py -> ngspice
edits_from_source: One symbol dependency, sg13g2_pr/simple_inductor.sym, is a PROJECT-LOCAL override (not in the standard IHP-Open-PDK path) shipped alongside this schematic; fetched directly from this repo (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IHP-GmbH/TO_May2025/main/LNA_2.45G/design_data/xschem/sg13g2_pr/simple_inductor.sym) and cached in lna/data/external/_tools/xschem_syms/ rather than guessed.

6 ESD diode instances (D2-D7, K{type=diode}) dropped automatically by the flattener's type classification -- same rationale as every prior circuit (process-level I/O protection, not part of the LNA topology).

No other manual edits -- unlike the earlier flat-SPICE IHP conversions, no hand-cleanup of X-prefixed devices or model-name heuristics was needed, because the flattener resolves device kind from each symbol's own K{type=...} field directly.

notes: MMn3/M4 (all four pins land on VSS) is kept exactly as the geometry reconstructs it -- plausibly a real dummy/matching transistor common in RF layout (tied off, present for symmetry, not for function) rather than a parser artifact: its pin coordinates were independently verified against real wire endpoints like every other device (the flattener does not special-case or silently drop degenerate devices). Flagged for user review if it turns out to matter downstream. Structural score 4/5 -- misses only lna_sized (18 devices, mostly from 5 realistic VDD-VSS decoupling caps + a 2-resistor/1-transistor bias generator on top of the 2-transistor RF core), not a defect. This is the first circuit whose ground truth came directly from a schematic-capture file rather than an already-flattened netlist -- see lna/data/reports/data-expansion-2026-08-09.md for the flattener's golden-test validation (reproduces the already-verified ihp-gps-lna-nmos conversion exactly: 3R/3L/2C/3M, score 5/5, from raw schematic source). Independent of, and unrelated to, the Kanchetla et al. TMTT 2022 paper this pipeline is blind-reproducing.
